name: Show validation for invalid migration planner input
description: Validates that the migration planner shows an error alert when prices or seat counts are invalid.

planSteps.description: Open the app home page, then click the 'Migration' link in the top navigation bar
Clear the 'Current price (USD)' field and type 0
Assert an alert with text 'Prices must be positive amounts.' is visible and 'MRR change' is not shown
Set 'Current price (USD)' back to 29.00, then replace the seats field with '1, 2.5'
Assert an alert with text 'Seat counts must be positive whole numbers.' is visible
